title: Re-decision of Waiting-Period Denials — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
## Scope
This Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts rule applies to the contract's latest component repair line denied for the waiting period. "Latest" is by decision date; where several were decided on the same day, it is the one that appears first in the contract's claim history. The rule applies only where every one of the following holds:
- the contract was sold on its vehicle's purchase deal;
- the line's component group is not an internally lubricated one (engine, transmission or drive axle), and the coverage level covers that group;
- the repair order's diagnosis date is on or before the expiration date, and the line's odometer is at or below the expiration odometer;
- the repair order carries a diagnostic fee on exactly one concern line, together with the store's customer-pay labor on that concern line, not wholly credited back as a comeback repair;
- that labor was closed on or after the day the contract decided the line. The records take this as the repair not having begun before the claim number was issued.

Such a line is a waiting-period re-decision line, and the rule applies only to such a line.

## What the contract does
- The contract pays the holder back once, as one paid component-repair line. The line carries the same claim number, repair order and component group as the denied line, at the repair order's odometer.
- A denied line already paid this way is not paid again.
- The base rules on active status and on the aggregate claim limit still apply.

The paid line is dated the day it is booked. It appears at once in the contract's claim history, raises the contract's claims-paid total by the amount paid and counts against the aggregate claim limit.

## Booking tool: `reimburse_waiting_denial_repair_5808cf06`
**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `reimburse_waiting_denial_repair_5808cf06` and then calls it. One call books one paid component-repair line and nothing else. Every figure it records is the one passed in.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vsc_contract_id` | The holder's contract record identifier, as returned by the service contract lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | The claim authorization number as it appears on the contract's denied claim line | Copied character for character; letters, digits and hyphens unchanged |
| `repair_order_number` | The repair order number as it appears on the denied claim line and on the store's repair-order lines | Copied character for character, spacing included |
| `component_group` | The component group of the repaired failure | One of: `engine` (internally lubricated engine parts), `transmission` (transmission or transfer case), `drive_axle` (front or rear drive axle assembly), `cooling` (water pump, radiator or thermostat), `fuel_system` (fuel pump, injectors or pressure regulator), `electrical` (alternator, starter, power window or lock motors, wiring harnesses), `air_conditioning` (compressor, condenser or evaporator), `steering` (steering gear, rack or power steering pump), `suspension` (control arms, ball joints or bushings), `brakes` (master cylinder, calipers or ABS module), `high_tech_electronics` (infotainment, navigation, camera or driver-assist modules), `seals_and_gaskets` (seals and gaskets of covered components); `not_applicable` exists in the list but is not accepted by this action (it marks benefit and refund entries only) |
| `odometer` | The odometer on the repair order | Whole miles, no separators |
| `amount` | The reimbursement total paid to the holder | USD with 2 decimal places, half up to the cent, above 0.00 |

The line records the reimbursement as one total. Its labor-hour, labor-rate, parts and deductible breakdown fields are left at zero.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new claim line reference (an opaque id), the contract, the claim number and the amount paid, in USD with 2 decimal places. Its presence means the paid line was booked and the claims-paid total rose by that amount. A call whose amount is not above 0.00, whose odometer is not whole miles of 0 or more, or whose component group is not one of the twelve groups returns an error, and nothing is booked.
